name: code/fix-bug
title: Fix a bug
summary: Fix a bug: reproduce it, find the line that causes it, change only that, run the tests, report what changed.
when: Use when something fails or misbehaves and the user wants the cause found and fixed, not guessed.
steps: Call run_command with the command or the steps that show the bug, and read the first error line.
Call grep_files with the error text and context_lines 2 to find the file and line that raises it.
Call read_file on that file with start and end around the failing line to see what the code expects.
Name the cause in one sentence before editing anything; if no line explains the error, stop and say what is unknown.
Change only that spot with apply_patch, or replace_in_file for one line, and keep the diff to the cause.
Call run_command with the same reproduction command again; if the error got worse, call undo_changes and try the next cause.
Call run_command with the project's test command, such as pytest, and read which tests pass or fail.
Answer with the cause, the file and line, what changed, and the test result.
next: The final answer must name the cause and its file and line, say what changed, and give the test result, or say plainly that the cause was not found.
